content: Customer Vihaan Patel contacted insurance agent Neha Kapoor upon noticing his auto policy had expired. Neha confirmed the policy expired the previous night, leaving him uncovered. Vihaan requested an immediate 12-month renewal with the same coverage and roadside assistance rider. Neha processed the renewal for $1,210, emailed the updated policy PDF, and confirmed payment will be charged to the Visa card on file ending in 1234.

action_items: Email updated policy PDF to customer
Charge payment to Visa card ending in 1234
